text:
Sophie L: Heads-up — we need a short migration guide + checklist for retiring the v1 shim next week. Primary asks: update docs PRs with v2 SDK snippets, add model-fallback guidance (model swaps can change tokenization), and surface link fixes. Who can own the doc PR? Marco P: I can take the PR coordination. Will do a pass on examples and the model-fallback section. Alice Z: I can audit snippets for the TypeScript SDK — there are a few callsites still using `client.models.generate` (v1). Ben R: I’ll look at embedding/semantic-search examples for any alias changes. Found one link in the search guide that points to the old `models` endpoint. Carla M: FYI: ops wants the rollback notes included — if users rely on the v1 shim for a specific model alias, we should mention canary rollback and how to pin to a specific model version. docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR template requires a migration checklist and example smoke-tests section. Sophie L: Good — Marco, can you add a short checklist at the top of the guide (1–3 bullets) so customers can scan quickly? Also include a tiny code snippet showing how to switch from v1->v2 for chat + how to configure a fallback. Keep it one clipboard-friendly example. Marco P: Drafted checklist in the thread: 1) Replace v1 client calls with v2 client + update imports. 2) Update any model alias references and confirm tokenization/regression with eval set. 3) Add a fallback route + health checks in the SDK example. Does that look OK? Sophie L: Yes. For (2) add a short sentence: "model swaps can change tokenization/stop sequences — re-run your prompt smoke tests." Alice Z: TS snippet — propose this minimal change (paste below). It's tiny and covers chat + fallback pattern. ``` // v1 (old) // const res = await client.models.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-chat', input: prompt }) // v2 (recommended) import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk' const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY }) // simple chat call const resp = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/fast-chat-v2', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }], streaming: false }) // fallback policy (pseudocode) try { return await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/fast-chat-v2', messages }) } catch (e) { // fallback to compatible variant return await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/fast-chat-v2-cpu', messages }) } ``` Marco P: That looks good. Add a line above the code: "If you pin using aliases, test token counts — v2 model families may have different tokenizer behavior." Ben R: For embeddings note: we renamed legacy alias `text-embed-old` -> `embed-1` in the catalog. I'll add a single-line callout pointing users to the alias map table + link. Carla M: For rollback instructions: include a tiny section in Troubleshooting: how to pin to an earlier model version via the Console (Model -> Pin version) and how to switch routing policy back to dedicated pool if capacity/regression occurs. Also include CLI command for Private deploys. Sophie L: Good. Can we also include a small test/QA checklist so docs reviewers can run a quick smoke test? E.g., 1) run snippet, 2) check token count parity (±10%), 3) validate stop sequences, 4) run small eval prompt set. Marco P: I'll add QA checklist and create the PR. Assigning reviewers: @Alice Z (sdk), @Ben R (examples/embeddings), @Carla M (ops/rollback). Alice Z: Quick note — some examples use inline HTML escaping that changed with the v2 streaming framing. I'll patch two snippets where we were trimming
incorrectly. Ben R: I'll double-check broken links in the search guide and send a tiny redirect PR if needed. Carla M: Ops will run a canary against staging traffic; we'll report any regressions by EOD Friday. If we see >3% regression on eval set, ops will pause the rollout. Sophie L: Sounds good. Marco, estimate of when the PR will be ready? Marco P: I'll open the PR today; expect ready for review in ~4 hours. Will include the checklist, snippets, alias map link, and a short rollback/ops section. Sophie L: Awesome — for communications, we should add a short deprecation blurb in the migration page and cross-link the deprecation FAQ. I'll draft the blurb and drop it in the PR description. deploy-bot: CI started for PR #4321 — lint, linkcheck, snippet-smoke-tests. Marco P: Noted — if linkcheck fails I’ll fix links. If the snippet-smoke-tests fail for streaming framing, I’ll switch streaming:false in the example to avoid flakiness and add a note explaining streaming differences. Alice Z: If anyone runs into tokenization diffs that look huge, ping me and I'll generate diffs with the tokenizer debug tool. Sophie L: Thanks everyone. After PR lands, I'll schedule the deprecation banner for the migration guide and confirm timing with marketing for email comms. Carla M: Adding to the checklist: "Ensure redirect rules for old docs links are in place before banner goes live." Marco P: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — includes checklist, snippets, alias map table, and Troubleshooting/rollback. Please review. Ben R: Reviewing now. Noted one broken link in the embeddings table — I'll send a quick fix commit. Sophie L: TL;DR: owner = Marco, reviewers = Alice/Ben/Carla, action items: update snippets, add alias map callout, QA checklist, rollback notes, redirect rules. Target: retire v1 shim next Wednesday. Carla M: Ops will confirm a final go/no-go on Monday after canary metrics. Sophie L: Perfect. Closing the loop — thanks all :rocket:
